tool.title: Days Between Dates Calculator
tool.intro: Calculate the number of calendar days between two dates without timezone ambiguity.
tool.formula: Both dates are interpreted as calendar dates and compared at UTC midnight. The absolute difference excludes the start date.
tool.caution: This is a date calculation, not an official event or public-holiday announcement.
